context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend rate-limits POST /api/daily-reports to 30/hour per IP. When running the pytest suite live, either wait one hour between runs OR temporarily flip RATE_LIMITING=off in /app/backend/.env, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, run tests, then restore. Backend takes ~30s after restart before ingress returns 200 (readiness delay).
rca_of_the_issue: Initial pytest run showed 24 failures — all were 429 rate-limit hits (30/hour cap on POST /api/daily-reports), not code bugs. Root cause: test file makes ~29 POSTs against the live preview backend, exceeding the 30/hour bucket after the first batch. Mitigation applied: set RATE_LIMITING=off in backend/.env, restart backend, rerun (29/29 PASS), then restore RATE_LIMITING=on.
